messages:
maria: kicking off config-only deploy for routing/batching tweaks. change window +30m. canary 5% for 15m. no model changes; just limits/timeouts/routing weight adjustments. link: https://console.redwood/team/releases/4291004321

maria: diff snippet:
```
/configs/routing.yaml
max_inflight_per_tenant: 120 -> 80
request_timeout_ms: 4000 -> 3000
batch_window_ms: 10 -> 8
routing_policy: weighted_snapshot_v2  # no model pin/swap
canary: 5% for 15m
```

deploy-bot: starting canary: 5% -> rollout window 15m. preflight checks passed. monitor: latency/p95, kv_evictions, 5xx-rate. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/release-configs

alex: quick flag - we saw kvcache evictions spike last week when batch_window dropped to 8ms on prod-2. can we scope tenants or stage smaller in that region? @maria @cheng

cheng: agree w/ alex. recommendation: target canary to east-1a only (low-traffic cohort) and exclude heavy tenants (tenant_ids: [acct-17, acct-42]). also add temporary throttle: tenant_soft_limit=0.8 to catch bursts.

maria: ok updating canary target and adding exclusions. new canary: east-1a, 3% traffic, exclude acct-17 acct-42, throttle soft limit 0.8. pushing change now.

deploy-bot: canary started (east-1a, 3%). metrics window open. reporting every 1m.

oncall-sre: FYI I'll watch observability dash. ping me if p95 increases >20% or 5xx >0.3%

(1m later) deploy-bot: canary metrics 60s:
- p50: +5ms
- p95: +22% (baseline 190ms -> 232ms)
- 5xx-rate: 0.05% -> 0.12%
- kv_evictions: +12% on canary hosts

alex: hmm p95 creeping. kv evictions climbing. suggest hold and investigate cache pressure before widening.

maria: agree. putting rollout on hold. not widening. @deploy-bot do not progress.

deploy-bot: rollout paused at 3%. awaiting manual action.

cheng: quick triage notes:
- batch_window drop reduces per-request batching; more concurrent inflight which stresses kvcache TTL churn
- request_timeout reduction from 4000->3000 means clients may see earlier timeouts under tail load
recommend revert request_timeout first and re-evaluate (less risky than restoring inflight limits).

maria: plan: 1) revert request_timeout to 4000 for canary only, 2) monitor 10m, 3) decide rollback full config if p95 doesn't recover. ok?

alex: +1. if p95 stays >15% above baseline after revert, we rollback to previous config revision.

oncall-sre: i'll run dashboard and alert rule. setting temporary alert: p95_canary_increase >15% for 2 consecutive mins -> page.

(ops action) alex: running canary patch now: `deploy-bot patch /configs/routing@canary --set request_timeout_ms=4000`

deploy-bot: applied patch to canary (east-1a). new canary config active.

(2m later) deploy-bot: canary metrics 120s post-patch:
- p95: baseline +8% (190ms -> 205ms)
- 5xx-rate: 0.06%
- kv_evictions: +8%

alex: that's better but still above threshold. per plan we monitor 10m. if no further improvement, rollback.

maria: agree. schedule: wait 8 more minutes then decide. thanks for quick action. :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: no paging so far. keeping watch.

(10m later) deploy-bot: canary 10m summary:
- p95: +9%
- 5xx-rate stable 0.06%
- kv_evictions trending down but still +6%

maria: given sustained p95 delta and kv pressure, decision: rollback config-only change to previous revision. we'll rework batching/inflight strategy and test in staging. initiating rollback now.

alex: executing rollback: `deploy-bot rollback /configs/routing --to rev-142 --scope canary,east-1a`

deploy-bot: rollback started. applying rev-142 to canary hosts.

(1m) deploy-bot: rollback complete. canary hosts are on rev-142. verifying metrics...

deploy-bot: verification 3m:
- p95: back to baseline (191ms)
- 5xx-rate: baseline 0.04%
- kv_evictions: baseline

maria: rollback verified. marking this deploy as aborted. will open a follow-up ticket to iterate on: alternative inflight reduction, gradual batch_window tuning, and tenant-specific throttles.

cheng: plz include load tests simulating tail latencies and kvcache churn. I can help with staging harness.

maria: thanks all. filing postmortem and notes in eng-releases channel and scheduling quick sync tomorrow 11:00 PT. link to ticket: https://tracker.redwood/ISSUE-2487

alex: thanks everyone. good catch and quick rollback. :white_check_mark:
